title: Shakira's Madrid Concert Sets an Amazon Music Livestream Record
summary:
Shakira's concert in Madrid on October 3 set a record. It is now the most-viewed livestream by a female artist on Amazon Music so far. Amazon Music shared the news on Sunday, October 4.

The show was part of Shakira's 12-date residency in Madrid, Spain, on her Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour. She performed at Shakira Stadium. It is a temporary venue built in Madrid just for the shows. The first show was on September 18, and the 12th show is on October 11.

There was a surprise. Pop singer Dua Lipa came onstage and sang an acoustic version of "Antología" with Shakira. The song is from Shakira's 1997 album Pies Descalzos. More than 50,000 fans watched in person. People at home could watch the livestream on Amazon Music, Prime Video and Twitch.

After the show, Dua Lipa wrote on Instagram that she felt she, Shakira and the audience "were one." She said she was grateful to take home such a beautiful memory.
why_it_matters: The record shows how many people now watch big concerts online, not only in the stadium.
